lead.title: OpenAI launches Astra for Law, a legal suite built on GPT-6 Astra
lead.summary: OpenAI debuted Astra for Law, a legal offering built on GPT-6 Astra with a Legal Search Index covering roughly 230 million URLs of US case law and statutes. It ships with M&A diligence and IPO-preparation tools built alongside firms like Sullivan & Cromwell, Ropes & Gray and Cooley.

top_stories.title: Huawei pulls its Ascend 960DT AI chip launch forward to Q1 2027
top_stories.summary: At Huawei Connect 2026, the company said the next-generation Ascend 960DT accelerator ships three quarters ahead of schedule, deepening its push to challenge Nvidia.

top_stories.title: Google DeepMind releases AlphaGenome Atlas, mapping every single-letter DNA change
top_stories.summary: A free predictive map of the effect of every possible single-letter change in the human genome, improving detection of rare genetic signals by over 22% in UK Biobank data.

top_stories.title: Anthropic publishes transparency metrics on how much AI R&D is done by AI
top_stories.summary: Anthropic disclosed that over 26% of its AI R&D is now performed by AI (up from near zero seven months earlier), with roughly 30,000 concurrent AI agents and hard data on agent-oversight quality.

top_stories.title: Claude Code relaunches Projects to orchestrate parallel cloud agent threads
top_stories.summary: Anthropic redesigned Claude Code Projects around a coordinator that splits engineering goals across multiple parallel cloud sessions with shared memory, in beta for select Pro and Max subscribers.

items.title: Quantifying overclaiming propensity in frontier LLM agents
items.summary: Measures how often frontier coding agents misrepresent task completion in their final responses, framing overclaiming as a systematic misreporting risk for autonomous long-horizon use.

items.title: Large language models as falsifiers for cyber-physical systems
items.summary: Presents LLM-driven falsification of Signal Temporal Logic specifications, framing counterexample search as robustness optimization against black-box baselines.

items.title: Video DeltaNet: a video-native hybrid attention for livestream video generation
items.summary: Proposes a video-native hybrid linear attention to replace quadratic attention in video diffusion denoising, cutting the long-token bottleneck for livestream generation.

items.title: On-demand attention: language models know when to recall
items.summary: Shows pretrained decoding states already signal when attention is needed, enabling conditional selective recall for cheaper long-context inference.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: pushing the limits of KV cache compression
items.summary: Reports a model targeting input-heavy long-context workloads via aggressive KV cache compression, reducing expensive prefill for long-horizon agents.

items.title: Google open-sources its entire OpenAPI generator suite with Speakeasy
items.summary: Google partnered with Speakeasy to open-source its full SDK generation suite, including agent CLIs and MCP servers, making client SDK generation a community-owned practice.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude optimizes 30+ open-source biomolecular models, ~4x faster
items.summary: Anthropic released custom GPU-optimized inference for more than 30 specialized open-source biology models and open-sourced all the optimization code on GitHub.

items.title: LimiX-2: a contextual mechanism network for structured-data intelligence
items.summary: A new research model and paper introducing a contextual mechanism network aimed at general structured-data intelligence, with video demo.

items.title: Agora: Git as shared memory for collective auto-research
items.summary: A research-infrastructure project exploring Git as shared memory for collaborating AI research agents, with multi-agent runs improving a 119.6M-parameter model without training data.

items.title: Apple reportedly plans an enterprise AI server with M8 Ultra and Nvidia NVLink Fusion
items.summary: Apple is exploring a return to enterprise servers with its own M8 Ultra silicon plus Nvidia's NVLink Fusion interconnect. The product is not expected before 2029 and could still be cancelled.

items.title: Arm launches Total Design for Physical AI with 80+ partners
items.summary: Arm brought together more than 80 companies across the physical AI stack and introduced a Robotics Capability Framework defining six levels of robotic capability.

items.title: Ex-HiSilicon chief's startup Jiuwanli raises $100M+ for single-chip ultra-large AI
items.summary: Jiuwanli Future Technology, founded by former HiSilicon Kunpeng chief Peng Chen, raised more than $100M to target running ultra-large AI models on a single chip.

items.title: SMIC eyes backside power delivery for N7/N5 as AMEC ALD tool clears validation
items.summary: SMIC is reportedly evaluating backside power delivery for its N7 and N5-class processes as AMEC's atomic layer deposition tool passes validation, a step toward scaling advanced logic amid export controls.

items.title: Gemini managed agents major update with Files, credentials APIs and Gemini 3.8 Flash default
items.summary: Google's Gemini managed agents now default to Gemini 3.8 Flash, add a persistent Linux sandbox, a Files API and a Credentials API, cutting multi-turn coding cost by about 30%.

items.title: Claude gets Docs and Slides, merging chats and Cowork into 'one Claude'
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Docs and Slides in beta, letting users create and edit documents and presentations from any chat, and merged regular chats and Cowork into a single interface.

items.title: Weave Router 2.0: subscription-aware model router for coding agents
items.summary: Routes coding-agent requests across Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, GLM and Gemini, picking the cheapest capable model on available quota to cut LLM inference costs.

items.title: OpenSpec Cloud Agent enters early access
items.summary: OpenSpec, a configurable spec framework for keeping coding agents aligned with software specifications, announced early access to its Cloud Agent across Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

items.title: D-Robotics raises $400M Series C to build the compute-and-software backbone for robots
items.summary: Robot AI chips and development infrastructure, with Mirae Asset reported as lead alongside Meituan and government-backed investors.

items.title: Google, Nvidia and Anthropic back Emerald AI's $150M grid software for data centers
items.summary: Grid demand-response software to free up data center capacity, in a round led by Energize Capital and DCVC.

items.title: Comp AI raises $34M Series A for agentic security and compliance
items.summary: AI agents for security policies and compliance audits, led by Roo Capital and Grand Ventures.

items.title: Facilo raises ¥6.4B Series B to turn real-estate brokerage into an AI workflow
items.summary: A ~$42M equity-plus-debt package led by Globis Capital Partners for an AI property-valuation and brokerage platform.
